route.line: A little water, a little patience.

greeting: Hello, traveller! I'm doing my rounds. The market is just down here.
return: Back again! Good to see a familiar face.
Hello again. The village has been keeping me busy.
talk: I check the supplies, water the plants, then sneak in a little rest. Come walk with me.
There's always something to do around here. But there's always time for a chat.
kill: That's one less pest to worry about. Thank you!
Good work! I'll keep these supplies out of their reach.

greeting: Welcome to Town. I'm on patrol, but I can spare a moment.
return: You again! Staying out of trouble, I hope.
Welcome back. Roads are looking quiet today.
talk: I make a circuit of the gate, the road and the market. Shout if you need me.
The best patrol is an uneventful one. Mind the monsters outside town.
kill: Nicely handled! Keep your eyes on the road.
I'll take watch from here. Catch your breath.

greeting: Oh, a new face! Welcome. I was just going to see my neighbours.
return: Hello again! It's nice having you around.
There you are! Fancy another stroll?
talk: I like to stop by the market and catch up with everyone. Town is full of little stories.
quest: I remember your help with those rats. Thank you for looking out for us!

steps.text: Does anyone know who keeps borrowing my basket?
Borrowing? I thought it was the village picnic basket!
Well... save me something from the picnic, then.
